Composio provides pre-verified enterprise Google connectors that work out of the box.
when_to_byoc: Custom branding: Display your own verified company logo and domain on Google's consent screen
Compliance custody: Organization policy requires internal custody of GCP client secrets and refresh tokens
Enterprise scopes: Accessing proprietary Google Workspace Admin SDK or internal Google Cloud APIs

summary: Hardest mainstream provider: sensitive/restricted scopes trigger mandatory Google OAuth verification, YouTube demo video, domain validation, and CASA security assessments.
difficulty_factors: +25 pts: App review mandatory for production (unverified apps capped at 100 test users with Google unverified warning)
+25 pts: Restricted scopes (Gmail/Drive) require high-scrutiny policy review
+20 pts: Third-party Cloud Application Security Assessment (CASA Tier 2/3) required for restricted scopes ($5,000–$15,000 fee [as of Nov 2026, source: appdefensealliance.org/casa/tier2])
+10 pts: Requires YouTube demo video submission and Google Search Console domain ownership verification

time_estimate.dev_wait_claim: Instant for test users (up to 100 users with unverified warning)
time_estimate.production_wait_claim: 2–6 weeks (official docs state 3–5 business days for initial review; community reports 3–6 weeks total cycle)
time_estimate.approval_wait: Instant for dev; 2–6 weeks for production review

prerequisites: Google Cloud Platform (GCP) account with billing account enabled
Custom domain with ownership verified via Google Search Console
Public Privacy Policy that includes a dedicated Google User Data Limited Use Disclosure
Recorded YouTube demo video (unlisted) showing client ID in URL bar and grant flow

path.detail: Open Google Cloud Console -> Create new Project. Navigate to APIs & Services -> Library -> Enable 'Gmail API' and 'Google Drive API'.
Choose User Type: 'External' (for any Google user) or 'Internal' (Workspace enterprise only). Fill App Name, Support Email, and authorized domains.
Add required scopes. Non-sensitive (profile/email) do not require review. Sensitive (drive.readonly) or Restricted (gmail.modify, mail.google.com) trigger verification.
While Publishing Status is 'Testing', explicitly add developer and tester Gmail addresses. Only these 100 emails can authenticate.
Go to Credentials -> Create Credentials -> OAuth client ID -> Web application. Add Authorized redirect URIs.

path.action: Submit for Verification & CASA Security Assessment
path.detail: Click 'Publish App'. Submit domain verification, privacy policy, justification letter, and YouTube unlisted demo link. If using restricted scopes, initiate CASA Tier 2 scan.

scopes.unlocks: Read files, metadata, and folders across Google Drive
View and manage only files created or opened by this agent (Recommended over full drive)
Send email messages on behalf of the user
Read, draft, label, and delete emails

approval.what_reviewed: Google Trust & Safety reviews branding, privacy policy compliance with Limited Use requirements, exact justification for each scope, OAuth consent screen flow in video demo, and CASA cyber assessment.
typical_rejection_reasons: Privacy policy does not include the exact 'Google API Services User Data Policy Limited Use' clause
YouTube video does not clearly display the Client ID in the browser URL bar or fails to show OAuth grant
Requesting broad scopes (e.g. mail.google.com) when a narrower scope (gmail.send) suffices
Domain not verified in Google Search Console under the same account as the GCP Project owner
what_to_prepare: Unlisted YouTube demo video showing end-to-end OAuth flow with browser address bar visible
Privacy Policy URL with Limited Use disclosure section
Google Search Console domain ownership verification token
Scope justification document explaining why an AI agent cannot function with narrower permissions

blockers_and_fixes.symptom: Google says 'This app isn't verified' with a red scary warning screen
blockers_and_fixes.cause: App is published or in testing mode, and user is not on the test users list, or OAuth consent screen has not passed verification.
blockers_and_fixes.fix: For testing: add user email under 'Test users' tab in GCP Console. For public launch: submit app for OAuth verification.
blockers_and_fixes.escalation_template: Hello Google Trust & Safety Team, regarding Project [PROJECT_NUMBER] and Client ID [CLIENT_ID], we have resolved the requested privacy policy disclosures and re-submitted our verification request.

blockers_and_fixes.symptom: Error 403: access_denied - You cannot sign in to this app because it doesn't comply with Google's OAuth 2.0 policy
blockers_and_fixes.cause: Attempting OAuth flow from an unapproved webview or using an unauthorized redirect URI.
blockers_and_fixes.fix: Google blocks embedded webviews for OAuth. Open system browser (external browser tab) and verify URI matches GCP console.

blockers_and_fixes.symptom: CASA Tier 2 assessment requirement notification from Google
blockers_and_fixes.cause: Triggered automatically when applying for restricted scopes (Gmail, Drive full access).
blockers_and_fixes.fix: Use an authorized CASA validation partner (e.g. PwC, Bishop Fox, Leviathan Security) or migrate to drive.file / Composio managed auth.

agent_can_do: Draft the exact Google Limited Use Disclosure markdown for your privacy policy
Generate detailed scope justification text explaining agent workflows for Google Trust & Safety
Write the verification submission description letter
Construct PKCE authorization code exchange and refresh token rotation handlers
you_must_do: Create Google Cloud Project and verify domain in Google Search Console
Record and upload the unlisted YouTube video showing the OAuth URL bar with client ID
Submit the verification form in GCP Console and pay CASA assessment fees if applicable
agent_vs_human.handoff_critical_point: Human must record the YouTube screencast showing the URL bar and submit the verification request in Google Cloud Console.

what_to_do_next: Check if Composio Managed Auth fits your use case (saves 3–6 weeks and thousands in CASA audits).
If BYOC is mandatory: Create GCP Project, enable Gmail/Drive APIs, and configure OAuth Consent Screen in 'Testing' mode.
Draft your Google Limited Use policy and scope justification using the agent generator.

evidence.claim: Google requires OAuth client creation in GCP console with strict HTTPS or localhost redirect URIs
evidence.snippet: Web applications must use HTTPS for all redirect URIs. HTTP is permitted exclusively for localhost development.

evidence.claim: Testing mode restricts OAuth to a maximum of 100 explicitly added test users
evidence.snippet: While publishing status is Testing, only users added to the test user list can access the app. The list is limited to 100 users.

evidence.claim: Gmail and Drive full scopes are classified as Restricted under Google API User Data Policy
evidence.snippet: Restricted scopes include full Gmail access and full Google Drive access. Using restricted scopes requires annual third-party CASA security verification.

evidence.claim: Unverified apps display a prominent 'Google hasn't verified this app' warning dialog
evidence.snippet: When a project requests sensitive or restricted scopes before verification is complete, users see an unverified app screen.

evidence.claim: Verification requires YouTube demo video, domain verification via Search Console, and privacy policy
evidence.snippet: You must provide an unlisted YouTube video link clearly showing the client ID in the address bar and demonstrating how requested scopes are used in the application.

uncertainties: Google CASA Tier 2 assessment pricing varies by authorized security lab ($3,000–$15,000+ as of Nov 2026); Google does not set official lab prices.
Initial Google review turnaround is stated as 3–5 business days, but multi-round email exchanges often prolong total approval to 4–6 weeks.
